يعتكدوا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَكِدُوا (yaʕtakidū) /jaʕ.ta.ki.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# يُعْتَكَدُوا (yuʕtakadū) /juʕ.ta.ka.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
